def transform(grid):
    panels = [grid[r][s:s+4] for s in (0,5,10,15) for r in range(4)]
    # panels list grouped per panel rows
    colors = [8,5,9,4]
    priority = [9,4,8,5]
    out=[]
    for r in range(4):
        row=[]
        for c in range(4):
            present={colors[k] for k in range(4) if panels[k*4+r][c] == colors[k]}
            row.append(next((x for x in priority if x in present),0))
        out.append(row)
    return out
PY
